$comment: NOT RENDERED. wave-ci reads only .buildkite/wave-ci.json. This file records every GitHub Actions job (or secret-bearing leg of a ported job) that is parked, with the reason and what unblocks it, so nothing is dropped silently. Classes: publish (deploy-class, waits for Jake to name it), event-bot (waits on the GitHub-event bridge, RUN-231 / wave-ci #132), secret (a main-only step needing a secret name that no allowlist row grants a public repository yet), registry (waits on the self-hosted npm registry, ruling WGL-0928-18). deferred_schedules lists GH schedule legs whose job is parked; ported schedules live in wave-ci.json `schedules`.

deferred_schedules.reason: release-drift.yml runs daily; its job (drift-check) is parked (needs a GitHub token for `gh release view`).
deferred_schedules.blocked_on: secret decision: a read-only GitHub token for this public pipeline, as a main-only step

schedule.name: release-drift-daily
schedule.label: daily npm / tag / GitHub Release drift check, 06:17 UTC (release-drift.yml schedule)

parked.reason: Tag-triggered (sdk-v*) npm publish with OIDC trusted publishing, a GitHub Release (contents: write) and an SBOM asset. Deploy-class; ruling WGL-0928-00 allows public SDK publishing but it is not enabled. The check content already runs on every build: secret-scan = secrets-content-policy, verify = lint + typecheck + test + smoke-install-node-20/22.
parked.blocked_on: Jake names the publish crossing; then a main_only, tag-gated step with an npm publish credential or OIDC federation

parked.reason: Runs on release: published (and from release.yml); uploads an SBOM to the GitHub Release with contents: write.
Installs @wave-av/governance@0.4.6 from GitHub Packages, which returns 403 (billing) for every install, and needs a packages read credential this public pipeline does not hold. Not worked around.
parked.blocked_on: self-hosted registry (ruling WGL-0928-18), then a governance-enforce step that diffs against the PR merge-base

parked.reason: scripts/release/drift-check.sh calls `gh release view`, which needs a GitHub token (GH passes GITHUB_TOKEN). It runs on main pushes and daily.
parked.blocked_on: secret decision: a read-only GitHub token name for step `version-drift` (main-only; the step key avoids the caps-lint deploy words)

jobs: smoke: README quickstart against the live gateway
parked.reason: The last smoke step calls the live gateway with WAVE_GATEWAY_API_KEY. GH skips it without the key; the ported smoke steps always take that skip.
parked.blocked_on: secret decision: WAVE_GATEWAY_API_KEY for a main-only live-smoke step

parked.reason: content-policy.sh checks private repository names only when GUARD_PRIVATE_REPOS is set (an org Actions variable on GH). Here it would be a job secret; the ported secrets-content-policy step runs without it, as a fork PR does on GH.
parked.blocked_on: secret decision: GUARD_PRIVATE_REPOS for a main-only content-policy step

parked.reason: Scans PR, issue, comment and review TEXT read from the GitHub event payload (issues, issue_comment, pull_request_review* events). Buildkite has no such trigger.
Triggered by labels and check_suite completion; acts with a GitHub App key (WAVE_AGENT_APP_ID, WAVE_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY).
Triggered by PR and issue_comment events; comments with an LLM key (OPENAI_KEY) and a write token.
Triggered by issues events; uses ISSUE_OPS_PAT, BOT_ISSUE_OPS_APP_ID, BOT_ISSUE_OPS_PRIVATE_KEY.
GitHub merge queue events have no Buildkite equivalent while GitHub's merge queue gates merges.
